name: Optimist
text: Weapon damage rises as the magazine empties (up to 30%). Counted here as the 15% average.

name: Strained
text: Gain critical hit damage while firing. Counted at full stacks.

name: Ranger
text: Amplifies weapon damage by 2% for every 5m to the target. Counted at 20m.

name: Killer
text: A critical hit kill grants bonus critical hit damage for 10s.

name: Close & Personal
text: A kill within 7m grants bonus weapon damage for 10s.

name: Sadist
text: Amplifies weapon damage to bleeding enemies.

name: Flatline
text: Amplifies weapon damage to pulsed enemies.

name: Ignited
text: Amplifies weapon damage to burning enemies.

name: Eyeless
text: Amplifies weapon damage to blinded enemies.

name: Rifleman
text: Headshots stack bonus weapon damage. Counted at 5 stacks.

name: In Sync
text: Hitting an enemy and using a skill each grant weapon and skill damage. Counted with both active.

name: Unhinged
text: More weapon damage at the cost of handling.

name: Fast Hands
text: Critical hits stack reload speed. Counted at full stacks.

name: Lucky Shot
text: Bigger magazine.

name: Perfect Lucky Shot
text: Bigger magazine.

name: Vindictive
text: Killing an enemy with a status effect grants crit chance and crit damage.

name: Measured
text: The top half of the magazine fires faster and the bottom half hits harder. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Preservation
text: Kills repair armor. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Perfect Determined
text: Headshot kills guarantee the next headshot. Not counted in the numbers.

name: Incessant Chatter
text: Exotic talent. Rate of fire grows as you fire. Counted at full stacks.

name: Plague of the Outcasts
